name: Find the Kittens 🐱
desc:
🐱 Welcome to Find The Kittens! Search through the map and collect cute kittens!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden kittens
🏆 Find all kittens the fastest for a spot on the leaderboard

🤝 Find kittens with friends and meet new friends along the way!
🎒 Equip the kittens you collect!
💬 If you want to suggest NEW kittens post a message on the 52 Cards group wall.
